metadata.short_desc: Refresh the system prompt while keeping the conversation
metadata.desc: Restores compliance with the system prompt in long conversations, or applies prompt changes without losing chat history. Backs up the conversation by default and continues in the original conversation.

command.hint: Admins can @ the bot or use the wake prefix, then send the command; private chat can send it directly.

command_name.hint: Defaults to refresh_prompt; case-insensitive, optional / or ! prefix.

confirm_word.hint: Defaults to confirm. The action only runs with this word.

require_admin.hint: Enabled by default. Turning it off lets everyone refresh the system prompt; not recommended.

backup.hint: Saves a copy of the current conversation, then refreshes the original conversation.

backup_before_refresh.hint: Creates an “original title_backup” conversation on every refresh. Disable to refresh in place without a backup.

copy.hint: After copy_chat confirm, saves the current conversation as “original title_backup” and continues in the original conversation.

copy_command_name.hint: Defaults to copy_chat; case-insensitive, optional / or ! prefix.

snapshot.hint: Writes the full current system prompt to the end of the conversation as a high-priority reminder.

replace_previous.hint: Enabled by default. Keeps only the latest system prompt snapshot in a conversation.

max_chars.hint: Limit the written prompt length when it is very long; 0 keeps the full text.

webui.hint: Caches the conversation list so opening the view is faster.

cache_ttl_seconds.hint: Defaults to 300. The view shows cached data first, then updates in the background; the top Refresh button bypasses the cache.

reply.hint: Refresh and backup results are sent by the plugin without calling the model.

strip_trailing_period.hint: Enabled by default. Removes the trailing “。” from replies sent to users.

reply_success.hint: Used when “backup before refresh” is disabled.

reply_success_backup.hint: Used when “backup before refresh” is enabled.

theme_color.hint: HTML color code, e.g. #22c55e; green by default.

refresher.prompt_not_cached: Prompt not recorded · send a message in this conversation

refresher.copy_id_hint: Click to copy the full conversation ID
refresher.id_copy_failed: Copy failed, please select the conversation ID manually
refresher.confirm_message_refresh: This will back up conversation “%s”, then write the latest system prompt snapshot into it. No message will be sent in chat. The first few messages after refreshing may have a lower cache hit rate and cost extra
refresher.confirm_message_refresh_no_backup: This will write the latest system prompt snapshot into conversation “%s”. No message will be sent in chat. The first few messages after refreshing may have a lower cache hit rate and cost extra
refresher.confirm_message_refresh_edit: This will back up conversation “%s”, then replace only the persona prompt snippet below and write the snapshot. The rest of the system prompt stays unchanged; no message will be sent in chat. The first few messages after refreshing may have a lower cache hit rate and cost extra
refresher.confirm_message_refresh_edit_no_backup: This will replace only the persona prompt snippet below in conversation “%s” and write the snapshot. The rest of the system prompt stays unchanged; no message will be sent in chat. The first few messages after refreshing may have a lower cache hit rate and cost extra
refresher.persona_unavailable: No persona prompt snippet found; the full system prompt will be used
refresher.confirm_message_copy: This will save conversation “%s” as a backup. The original conversation stays unchanged
refresher.backup_title_placeholder: Enter a name for the backup
refresher.confirm_message_delete: This permanently deletes conversation “%s” and all of its chat history. This cannot be undone
refresher.confirm_message_clear: This will delete the system prompt snapshot written by a refresh, undoing the refresh reinforcement. Chat history, persona/system prompt settings, and backup conversations are untouched
refresher.refresh_disabled_hint: Send a message in this conversation first so the plugin can record the system prompt
refresher.refresh_need_record: “%s” has no recorded system prompt yet. Send a message in this conversation first, then refresh
